native_drawable_function.name: -[MyEAGLView initWithFrame:withBits:withUseDepth:andRenderers:]

interpretation.supported: The constructor selects ordinary RGBA8 for 32-bit drawables, RGB565 otherwise, opaque presentation and non-retained backing. No sRGB renderbuffer or gamma conversion branch exists in this constructor. Preserve game-channel arithmetic while correcting the host presentation metadata.
interpretation.not_established: This static constructor evidence does not recover UIKit display color management, original-device ICC profiles or exact original screenshots. The macOS fix is supported separately by current dependency source, upstream correction and local compositor measurement.
